name: Kurt Vardeman
text: Alexis is a great coworker and member of the Custom Development Team. One thing I love about Alexis is that when he solves a problem, his solution is always well thought-out and is coded in a clean, easy-to-understand way. He is frequently tasked with solving difficult problems, and never hesitates to tackle them, even if it requires learning a new skill or framework. I appreciate his friendliness, teamwork, and expertise.

name: Francisco Cáceres
text: Alexis is a highly committed software professional with strong leadership skills. During our time working together in a startup environment, he consistently demonstrated responsibility, initiative, and technical excellence. He leads by example and brings a strong sense of ownership to every project he is involved in.

name: Viviana Laurido Aguirre
role: Senior Software Developer @ TechSoft Systems S.A.
text: Alexis possesses leadership qualities and extensive technical knowledge; he is always eager to learn and adopts a decision-oriented approach to his work. He is a team player who is open to feedback, constantly striving for improvement to ensure the success of assigned projects.

text: Alexis is an excellent team player who is always willing to support others. He has strong technical skills, a solid foundation in software engineering, and consistently demonstrates a genuine eagerness to learn and expand his skill set.
